_doc: Copy-trade crowd sources (Tier-1 sweep row #10, class A2). ROWS, NEVER CODE: an adapter of 'none' is a named gap with its blocked_by. Public, logged-out pages only. A login wall or 401/403/429/451 is recorded and never routed around; a robots.txt Disallow on the path, or a refused or unreadable robots.txt, stops the fetch (desk-wide ruling 2026-11-10): no login, cookie, proxy, CAPTCHA or paywall step exists in this producer.

mql5_signals.positions_evidence: measured 2026-11-03: /en/signals/<id>/positions serves only 'To see trades in realtime, please log in or register'. Open positions are never read. The public page's per-symbol Distribution table and Long/Short trade counts are read instead, and their change between visits is the flow book.

fxblue.positions_evidence: 2026-11-03 cloud probe of a stub account showed the statement shell with no rows; whether a live public account serves open positions logged out is measured by the first box pass (a login wall is recorded as BLOCKED_AUTH and the route stops).

myfxbook.positions_evidence: public system pages carry an Open Trades tab unless the owner hides it; read from the served HTML only. robots.txt could not be read from the cloud on 2026-11-03; the box pass labels it.

myfxbook_api.blocked_by: BLOCKED_AUTH: the Myfxbook API needs a login session and only returns the session owner's own accounts. The held MYFXBOOK key cannot read the public crowd.
myfxbook_api.next: none; the public system pages above are the lawful route

darwinex.blocked_by: NO_PUBLIC_POSITIONS: DARWIN public pages show returns and risk, not open positions; robots Disallow /api.
darwinex.next: read public DARWIN return series as a quality cohort only if a positions source appears

sentiment._doc: Broker-side retail sentiment rows (2026-11-11). ROWS, NEVER CODE. terms OPEN = no restriction found; UNREAD = not yet read (fetched under robots + hard stops, never redistributed); RESTRICTS_REDISTRIBUTION = held internally, never redistributed; FORBIDS = never fetched. Evidence read 2026-11-11 from the cloud.

myfxbook_outlook.evidence: 2026-11-11: page served logged out with the long/short table (Short/Long %, lots, positions, average entry prices, popularity). /robots.txt and /terms did not load from the cloud; the box pass reads robots first and stops on a Disallow, refusal or outage. 2026-08-26 the VPS saw a Cloudflare managed challenge on the whole host: if the box sees one, the page carries no table and nothing is parsed; the challenge is never passed.

ig_client_sentiment.evidence: 2026-11-11: https://www.ig.com/uk/site-terms-and-conditions has no automated-access clause; it says content may not be 'reproduced, adapted, uploaded to a third party' and data may not be 'retransmit[ted], redistribute[d], publish[ed]'. Held internally for research only, never redistributed or published. robots.txt (User-agent: *) disallows /content/, /etc/, /js/, /*?*state=* -- none match these market pages. Each page: 'X% of client accounts are long|short on this market', updated every 15 minutes.

dukascopy_swfx.blocked_by: TERMS_FORBID: https://www.dukascopy.com/swiss/english/legal-pages/terms-of-use/ clause 3: 'You shall not use or attempt to use any "scraper," "robot," "bot," "spider," "data mining"' ... 'without the prior express written consent of DUKASCOPY'; also 'may not be used to construct a database of any kind'. Never fetched.
